description: Ataytis Vega Studio is a custom visual for Microsoft Power BI that lets you build fully custom report visuals with Vega JSON. Instead of starting from a fixed chart type, Vega Studio gives you a blank visual canvas where the result is defined by your specification. Use it when the visual you need does not exist, when a standard chart is close but not quite right, or when a report needs a more specific layout, structure, or visual design than the default Power BI visuals can provide. Why Ataytis Vega Studio? Ataytis Vega Studio is built for creators who want more freedom over visual design inside Power BI without developing, packaging, and maintaining a separate custom visual for every idea. Key capabilities: Build fully custom Power BI visuals using Vega JSON. Create visuals that are not limited to a predefined chart type, layout, or formatting panel. Design the structure, layout, styling, data-driven behaviour, and presentation of the visual through a Vega specification. Write, edit, preview, and refine Vega code directly inside Power BI. Render the finished visual on the Power BI report canvas as part of the normal report experience. Use Power BI fields as the data source for your Vega specification, so the visual is driven by report data.
